title: ClipForge Mobile (Web/PWA on Internet Computer): Offline-capable video & photo editor with templates + remote config/OTA-like updates

requirements.text: Implement a mobile-first, app-like web UI (PWA-style) for “ClipForge Mobile” that runs smoothly on mobile browsers (iOS Safari/Android Chrome) with bottom navigation tabs: Home, Templates, Create, Projects, Profile; include dark mode and light mode.

quotes:
Bottom navigation:
Home
Templates
Create
Projects
Profile
Dark & light mode
Smooth animations

acceptanceCriteria: App has a persistent bottom navigation with the 5 tabs and sensible routes/screens for each.
A theme toggle (or system-aware theme) switches between dark and light mode and applies consistently across screens.
UI is mobile-first and works at common phone widths without horizontal scrolling.

requirements.text: Create a cohesive “CapCut-inspired” editing UI/UX theme (without copying branding) with a clean modern SaaS look: typography, spacing system, component styles, motion/transition guidelines, and consistent use across the app (avoid blue/purple as primary colors).

quotes: inspired by the UI/UX style of CapCut

acceptanceCriteria: A documented design theme is applied across key screens (Home/Templates/Create/Projects/Profile + editor screens).
Primary color palette does not use blue/purple as the main accent.
Interactive elements (buttons, tabs, modals, sliders) share consistent styling and motion.

requirements.text: Implement an offline-first local data layer for projects, imported media metadata, and downloaded templates with instant loading on repeat visits (use browser storage such as IndexedDB/localStorage as appropriate).

quotes: Local storage using SQLite or AsyncStorage

Download once → available offline
Stored locally
Load instantly

acceptanceCriteria: Projects list persists across refreshes and is available offline.
Template downloads are cached locally; subsequent opens do not require network access.
The app gracefully handles offline mode (no crashes; user sees offline indicators where relevant).

requirements.text: Build a Templates section with preloaded editable template catalog entries for: Video (TikTok intro, YouTube intro, Slideshow, Birthday video, Business promo) and Photo (Instagram post, YouTube thumbnail, Poster, Resume cover, Flyer). Each template must be editable and downloadable/cached for offline use.

quotes:
Preload free editable templates:
Video:
TikTok intro
YouTube intro
Slideshow
Birthday video
Business promo
Photo:
Instagram post
YouTube thumbnail
Poster
Resume cover
Flyer
Templates must:
Be editable
Download once → available offline
Stored locally
Load instantly

acceptanceCriteria: Templates screen shows the listed template items grouped by Video/Photo.
User can open a template into an editor with editable layers/fields (e.g., text fields, placeholder media) and save as a new project.
Downloading a template once makes it available offline on subsequent app loads.
Backend provides a canonical template catalog endpoint (or config) that the frontend consumes.

requirements.text: Implement a video editor experience (offline-capable) with a timeline-based UI supporting multi-layer composition (video, audio, text, stickers) and essential operations: trim, split, crop, transitions, text animations, music library selection, speed control, filters/color adjustments, and export options for 720p and 1080p with no watermark.

quotes:
🎬 Video Editor Features (Offline)
Timeline-based editor
Multi-layer editing (video, audio, text, stickers)
Trim, split, crop
Add transitions
Text animations
Music library
Speed control
Filters & color grading
Export 720p / 1080p
No watermark (Free version)

acceptanceCriteria: Timeline UI supports multiple tracks/layers and a playhead.
User can add/edit at least: a text layer and a sticker layer; trim/split a clip; adjust speed; apply at least one filter/color adjustment.
Pinch-to-zoom (or equivalent) works on the timeline on touch devices.
Export flow allows selecting 720p/1080p and produces a downloadable file without watermark branding.

requirements.text: Implement a photo editor experience (offline-capable) supporting crop/resize, filters/presets, brightness/contrast/saturation controls, adding text and stickers, background blur, a basic background removal option, and export to JPG/PNG.

quotes:
📸 Photo Editor Features (Offline)
Crop / resize
Filters & presets
Brightness / contrast / saturation
Add text & stickers
Blur background
Basic background removal (on-device AI)
Export JPG / PNG

acceptanceCriteria: User can import/select an image into the photo editor and apply crop/resize and at least one filter.
Brightness/contrast/saturation controls update the preview and persist to the saved project.
Export produces JPG or PNG as selected.
Background blur is available; background removal is exposed as a tool (may be a basic/approximate implementation).

requirements.text: Implement a dynamic update architecture using a remotely configurable JSON document for: feature toggles, enabling/disabling tools, adding/removing templates, and a remote template repository with download + cache. Include version check on app launch, silent background refresh of config, and a user prompt when a major version change is detected.

quotes:
🔄 Auto-Updatable System (Very Important)
Implement dynamic update architecture:
OTA updates for app logic (no store re-submission required)
Remote JSON config for:
Feature toggles
Adding/removing templates
Enabling/disabling tools
Remote template repository (download & cache)
Version check on app launch
Silent background updates
“New update available” prompt if major changes

acceptanceCriteria: Backend exposes an endpoint/method returning the remote config JSON (versioned).
Frontend fetches config on startup, caches it locally, and uses it to show/hide tools and templates without redeploying the frontend bundle.
Frontend performs a silent background refresh and updates cached config when minor changes occur.
When config major version changes, the UI displays a clear “New update available” prompt with a refresh action.

requirements.text: Add Projects management: list, search/sort, duplicate, delete, and open projects (video/photo/template-derived). Store project metadata and editor state locally for offline use.
acceptanceCriteria: Projects tab lists saved projects and supports opening them into the appropriate editor.
User can delete a project and it is removed from local storage.
Project list loads without network access.

requirements.text: Add a feature-gating system that supports Free vs Pro entitlements as an optional toggle: Pro gates premium templates, advanced transitions, and advanced color grading controls; include UI indicators/upsell entry points but keep the app functional on Free.

quotes:
💰 SaaS Monetization (Optional Toggle)
Free plan: All basic tools
Pro plan:
Premium templates
Advanced transitions
Advanced color grading
Stripe or in-app purchase integration
Feature gating system

acceptanceCriteria: There is a single source of truth for entitlements (Free/Pro) consumed by the UI to enable/disable gated features.
Premium templates and advanced tools are visibly marked and cannot be used on Free (with an explanatory prompt).
A configuration toggle (remote config or build flag) can disable monetization/Pro entirely and remove gating UI.

requirements.text: Backend: implement Motoko canister APIs for (a) remote config/versioning, (b) template catalog metadata, and (c) optional user-scoped cloud sync scaffolding that can be turned off by config (no third-party auth; use Internet Identity if authentication is needed).
acceptanceCriteria: Backend provides query/call methods to fetch remote config and template catalog metadata.
APIs are versioned (at least via a version field) so the frontend can detect major/minor changes.
If cloud sync is enabled, backend provides basic CRUD endpoints for user-scoped project metadata (authentication via Internet Identity when enabled).

requirements.text: Provide an app architecture deliverable inside the repo (documentation) describing: folder structure, state management approach, offline storage strategy, editor engine approach, and the dynamic update system flow (startup/version check/background refresh).

quotes:
📦 Deliverables
Full app architecture
Folder structure
State management system
Editor engine setup
OTA update setup
Store-ready build configuration

acceptanceCriteria: Repo contains a readable architecture document explaining major modules and data flows.
Document includes how templates are defined, downloaded, cached, and instantiated into editable projects.
Document describes how remote config is fetched, cached, and applied (including major update prompt).

requirements.text: Generate and include required static brand/UI assets (icon, splash/hero, and empty-state illustrations) and render them from the frontend as static files under frontend/public/assets/generated.
acceptanceCriteria: Generated images exist under frontend/public/assets/generated and are referenced by the UI (e.g., app header/landing, empty states).
Assets are loaded directly by the frontend (not via backend calls).

constraints: Must use the existing Internet Computer template stack: Motoko backend + React (TypeScript) frontend with Tailwind + React Query; do not introduce React Native/Flutter, Firebase/Supabase, CodePush/Expo Updates, or native mobile bindings.
Backend must remain a single Motoko actor in backend/main.mo; only add migration.mo if upgrading existing persisted state.

Do not edit any frontend files under immutable paths: frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, frontend/src/components/ui (compose/extend instead).
Use English for all user-facing text.
nonGoals: Full native iOS/Android app packaging and App Store/Play Store submission workflows.
True on-device FFmpeg mobile bindings, Skia/native rendering, and native in-app purchases/Stripe SDK integration.
Real-time collaboration, chat, WebSockets, push notifications, or third-party authentication providers.

required: App icon with a minimal clip/forge motif, dark-friendly, flat vector style (clipforge-app-icon.dim_1024x1024.png)
Splash/hero illustration showing abstract timeline strips and photo frames, clean modern style (clipforge-splash.dim_1242x2688.png)
Empty state illustration for Projects (minimal editor-themed illustration) (clipforge-empty-projects.dim_1200x800.png)
Empty state illustration for Templates (cards/grid themed illustration) (clipforge-empty-templates.dim_1200x800.png)
